learning_outcomes.text: Know and apply European Directives and current regulations in Spain oriented towards energy saving and improving energy efficiency in industrial facilities.
Understand the key aspects to evaluate and the phases to carry out in an industrial energy audit.
Identify and assess possible energy saving and efficiency measures in horizontal systems and production processes applicable to the industrial sector.
Understand the fundamentals of cogeneration and its associated technologies, as well as applicable legislation.
Work on practical cases of energy auditing in the industrial sector, evaluating the improvements achieved with different technological solutions.

syllabus_topics: Energy auditing and management in industry.
Energy efficiency in horizontal systems and technologies (processes, equipment, and systems present in all types of industries: boilers, engines, combustion, insulation, etc.).
Energy efficiency in production processes (textile, cement, ceramic, etc.) and cogeneration.
Practical cases of energy audits in different industrial sectors.

assessment_methods.method: Delivery of practical cases (Entrega de casos prácticos - ECP)

assessment_rules: For continuous assessment students, if the written exam score (EX) is 3.5 or higher, the final grade is calculated as (0.2 x IP) + (0.3 x ECP) + (0.5 x EX). If EX is less than 3.5, the final grade is EX. For differentiated assessment students, the formula depends on which components (IP, ECP) have been submitted. A minimum course grade of 5.0 is required to pass the subject. In extraordinary calls, a single theoretical exam (EX) is taken, requiring a minimum of 3.5 points; if met, the previous component weights (IP, ECP) apply, otherwise the grade is EX.
